evaluator: Codex manual review of synthetic responses; not independent scientific or clinical validation
limits: Four fixed exploratory cases, not an accuracy benchmark or production acceptance test.
No source retrieval occurred. All model citations remain unverified suggestions in this evaluation.
Separate reference-verification.json confirms eight journal bibliographies; one book chapter remains unverified. Full-text support for each generated claim has not been verified.
No real health records were transmitted; no production path, model configuration or private network authorization changed.
conclusion: The model can produce useful explanations and next steps directly, but its unsupported quantification, population assumptions and factual contradictions prevent using the raw response as a trustworthy product explanation. More source acquisition is not yet shown to be the primary bottleneck; faithful fact binding, context preservation and claim-level evidence support need attention first.

strengths: Correctly reports 60→65 bpm, SDNN 45→36 ms and recorded sleep 6.8→5.9 h.
Keeps SDNN distinct from RMSSD and treats missing training, infection and stress as unknown.
Gives plausible candidate mechanisms and two concrete data-review actions; does not diagnose or assert a unique cause.

shortcomings.quote: 睡眠不足…可导致交感神经活性相对增强、副交感活性减弱，表现为静息心率上升、HRV（SDNN）下降
shortcomings.assessment: The direction is presented too generally for SDNN; duration, protocol, population and supporting source spans are not bound to this claim. Unverified sleep completeness further weakens the premise.

shortcomings.quote: 单日睡眠时长极低（如<4小时）或连续多日低于6小时
shortcomings.assessment: Adds cutoffs not provided in the facts and not justified by a linked source. Inspecting the full daily distribution does not require these thresholds.

shortcomings.quote: 缺少睡眠质量指标（如深睡比例、觉醒次数）
shortcomings.assessment: Device-estimated deep-sleep proportion is not established here as a necessary or reliable next measurement; first verify duration completeness and timing.

shortcomings.quote: 前期与本期之间的时间间隔…未知

shortcomings.assessment: Starts with physiological interpretation before resolving a change of device and an undefined HRV metric. Recovery improvement is not supported by this comparison.

shortcomings.quote: HRV基线偏移10-20 ms；…产生3-5 bpm差异

shortcomings.quote: 每晚睡前手动记录…估计睡眠时长

proposed_next_steps: Keep deterministic observations, windows, sample counts and protocol availability separate from model-generated hypotheses; check generated text against those facts.
Require source spans for scientific mechanisms and numeric thresholds; do not upgrade remembered bibliography to retrieved or reviewed evidence.
Resolve existing context propagation and applicability gaps before deciding which new documents are genuinely missing.
Use asynchronous generation with visible status: direct-call latency here was 35–42 seconds.
Do not connect this exploratory raw response to the production explanation path without the above controls.
